interpretation: CPU0sequentialABBA with exact prior native libraries. Placement uses one new common caller, exact strides/addresses/counters checked. Small-repeat uses original byte-identical binaries, with cases selected from earlier losses plus matching families/neighbors/controls. Neither scope is a new general all-layout estimate. paired.csv times are ns/value; retained raw cases follow their reported call/value item units.
units: CPU/real times are ns per benchmark iteration. ns_per_item uses the reported item rate; an item means what the benchmark counts, not necessarily a value or byte.
